ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels with a contrast ratio of approximately 5:1 white-to-black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white pigmentation centrally. High-contrast black mottling and fractal-like patterns on the far left lobe margin. Distinctive vertical black pigment line extending downward from the median notch. Three isolated circular dark spots on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a sharp interior angle and high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with significant pixel-amplitude peaks along the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Three distinct, roughly circular dark pixel clusters on the right lobe. Smaller dark clusters present along the upper margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 6-8 parallel vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the lower inner left lobe. Single diagonal dark linear mark on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake mark scarring on the lower left lobe quadrant.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-hatched, intricate line pattern on the outer-most edge of the left lobe.
